statements: STEP 30A Phase A registers a final-candidate benchmark of existing trajectories only; no trajectory is generated and no metric is computed here.
Candidate = GLORYS12V1 15.810070 m + WW3 Stokes x 1.0 + NCEP-R2 alpha 0.002 (STEP 29 treatment); baseline = HYCOM 15.000 m + NCEP-R2 alpha 0.002 (STEP 25C / STEP 20); both fixed and never re-run.
The STEP 29 comparison (candidate vs GLORYS) and the STEP 30A comparison (candidate vs HYCOM) are distinct and will be reported side by side.
No alpha, coefficient, depth or forcing change; no blending; no selection; holdout descriptive only.
